exposure: preoperative Edinburgh Postpartum Depression Scale (EPDS) score (<10 vs. ≥10)
cohort: This study included 1,230 singleton pregnant women who underwent elective cesarean section (CS) at a tertiary referral hospital in China between October 2017 and September 2019.
finding: Tramadol PCIA did not significantly reduce the overall incidence of PPD at 4 weeks after elective CS, but it was associated with a lower incidence of PPD in high-risk women (EPDS ≥10) compared to hydromorphone PCIA and ropivacaine PCEA.
